name: Yuugure Tokoyo
source:
[b]A Talkative, but Emotionless [i]Kouhai[/i][/b]

Grade: First-year/internal student, student council secretary

A mysterious [i]kouhai[/i] who never laughs. She rarely shows emotion, but is very talkative, and becomes tired when she talks a lot. Even though she is shy, strangely, she feels very familiar to [url=/c128223]Kanata[/url], but still a mysterious girl nonetheless. Also, she does not have any friends. Perhaps because of thinking that she will be rich if she can smile naturally, she takes a lot of part-time jobs, so she can be found everywhere. She currently lives with her father who is the school principal.

"My smile is one hundred million yen."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232470]Getchu[/url]]
